Hull City vs Brentford. Premier League.
MKM Stadium.
Hull City 1-1 Brentford: Dango Ouattara rescues point for Bees after Oli McBurnie penalty
Report and free match highlights as Dango Ouattara's second-half equaliser earns Brentford a 1-1 draw at Hull after Oli McBurnie's penalty put the hosts ahead, extending Hull's winless Premier League run to six games
Sunday 25 October 2026 16:28, UK
Brentford fought back to earn a 1-1 draw at Hull City after Dango Ouattara cancelled out Oli McBurnie's first-half penalty, extending the hosts' winless run in the Premier League to six games.
Hull had looked on course for a valuable victory after taking the lead in the 25th minute. Brentford goalkeeper Caoimhin Kelleher played a poor pass towards Aaron Hickey, allowing Everton loanee Tim Iroegbunam to win possession before being brought down by the defender. Hickey received a yellow card and McBurnie calmly converted from the spot to score his first Premier League goal of the season.

Sergej Jakirovic's side were the better team for much of the first half, disrupting Brentford's rhythm and limiting their attacking threat. Hull also appealed unsuccessfully for a second penalty when Regan Slater went down under a challenge from Sepp van den Berg. At the other end, Semi Ajayi impressed with his defensive work as Brentford struggled to create clear chances.
Keith Andrews' side improved after the break and found their equaliser in the 63rd minute. Igor Thiago helped keep a ball alive in the box before setting up Ouattara, who finished from close range to bring Brentford level. The visitors grew in confidence after the goal, with substitutes Mikkel Damsgaard and Aaron Anthony helping to inject fresh energy into their attack.
Both sides had opportunities to win it late on. Hull goalkeeper Konstantinos Tzolakis denied a close-range effort from Mohamed-Ali Cho, while substitute Joe Gelhardt was unable to convert a late chance after good work from Cho.
The draw leaves Hull still searching for a first league victory in six games, while Brentford return home with a point after recovering from a disappointing first-half display. Brentford are now sixth in the Premier League with 11 points from eight games, while Hull climb to 10th on 10 points.

The key moments from the MKM Stadium
25: GOAL! McBurnie puts Hull ahead from the penalty spot after a dreadful Kelleher pass leaves Hickey in trouble and Iroegbunam is fouled. The striker makes no mistake.
32: NO PENALTY! Slater goes down in the box under a challenge from van den Berg, but the referee's decision not to award a spot-kick stands after a check.
63: GOAL! Brentford are level! Thiago keeps the ball alive in the area and tees up Ouattara, who taps home from close range to bring the Bees back into the game.
71: SAVE! Kelleher produces a superb reaction stop to deny Cho from close range after the ball squeezes through van den Berg's legs.
74: SAVE! Tzolakis keeps Brentford at bay, stopping Anthony's header after Ouattara delivers from the right.
89: BIG CHANCE! Cho drills a ball across the six-yard box and Gelhardt gets a touch, but can only direct his effort wide.
